subject: general
question: In which year did the Indian Constitution come into effect?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1950**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Constitution of India** officially came into effect on **January 26, 1950**. This date was specifically chosen to commemorate the declaration of **Purna Swaraj** (Complete Independence) by the **Indian National Congress** in **1930**.
 
• While the Constitution was **adopted** by the **Constituent Assembly** on **November 26, 1949**, it was legally enforced two months later to mark the historical significance of **Republic Day**. ***Hence, the option 1950 is correct.***
 
• With the enforcement of the Constitution, the **Government of India Act 1935** was repealed, and India transitioned from a **British Dominion** to a **Sovereign Democratic Republic**.
 
• The **Constituent Assembly** took precisely **2 years, 11 months, and 18 days** to complete the drafting of the world's lengthiest written constitution.
 
• At the time of its commencement in **1950**, the Constitution consisted of a **Preamble**, **395 Articles** (divided into **22 Parts**), and **8 Schedules**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Significance of other years mentioned in the options:**
 
 
• **1947:** This year marks the **Indian Independence Act**, through which India gained freedom from British rule on **August 15, 1947**. However, the country continued to be governed by modified colonial laws until the Constitution was enacted.
 
• **1949:** On **November 26, 1949**, the drafting process was finalized, and the document was signed by the members of the **Constituent Assembly**. This day is now celebrated annually as **Constitution Day** (Samvidhan Divas).
 
• **1952:** This year is significant as it saw the conclusion of India's **first General Elections** (held between October 1951 and February 1952) and the formation of the first democratically elected **Parliament** of India.
 
 
 
• **The Drafting Committee:**
 
 
• The **Drafting Committee**, which was responsible for preparing the final text, was chaired by **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar**, who is recognized as the **Father of the Indian Constitution**.
 
• Other prominent members included **Alladi Krishnaswamy Iyer**, **N. Gopalaswami Ayyangar**, and **K.M. Munshi**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Original Manuscript:** The original Constitution of India was not printed but **handwritten** (calligraphed) in both **Hindi and English** by **Prem Behari Narain Raizada**.
 
• **Artistic Decoration:** Each page of the original document was uniquely decorated by artists from **Shantiniketan**, including **Nandalal Bose** and **Beohar Rammanohar Sinha**.
 
• **Universal Adult Franchise:** One of the most revolutionary features of the 1950 Constitution was the introduction of **Universal Adult Suffrage**, granting every citizen above a certain age (originally **21 years**, later reduced to **18 years** by the **61st Amendment**) the right to vote regardless of gender, caste, or education.
 
• **Borrowed Features:** The Indian Constitution is often described as a "bag of borrowings" because it incorporated best practices from various countries, such as **Parliamentary Democracy** from the **UK**, **Fundamental Rights** from the **USA**, and **Directive Principles** from **Ireland**.
